exceptions.title: Named human control owners not assigned
exceptions.mitigation: Record human accountable owner per control before independent evidence intake; do not substitute an AI or role label.

exceptions.title: No independent production-like environment observations
exceptions.mitigation: Require authorized isolation and redacted signed receipts; only safe read-only preparation in this slice.

exceptions.title: External provider and monitoring acceptance not evidenced
exceptions.mitigation: No broker connection or provider test until separately authorized; collect controlled independent evidence later.

exceptions.title: Legacy exposure inventory and governance review incomplete
exceptions.mitigation: Obtain independent inventory disposition and human approval; leave decisions NO-GO.

exceptions.title: Runtime product and device regression not rerun in this slice
exceptions.mitigation: Run isolated account, workspace, modal, mobile and backend policy tests; distinguish historical runs from newly observed results.
